title: You, the artist
description: Be an artist. Artists make art for no other reason other than to express themselves. Identifying as an artist forces you to reevaluate your work through a lens of uniqueness. No on
html:
Be an artist.

Artists make art for no other reason other than to express themselves.

Identifying as an artist forces you to reevaluate your work through a lens of uniqueness.

No one can copy your uniqueness because there is only one version of you and you are the best at it.

You’ll breathe life into your work.

And you might stop caring about what other people think and create things just because your work is beautiful to you.

That’s art.
